data.current_summary: Check records or create the Statement 3 JSON file
data.current_description: action=validate needs no account and returns every error with its path and a plain-language fix. action=generate needs an account that has paid for the claim (one GSTIN and From/To period; one payment covers both files and all corrections) and returns the file. Amounts may be strings or numbers; dates DD-MM-YYYY; periods MMYYYY. A JSON file made by the official offline utility is accepted as data unchanged. Limits: 8 MB and 10000 rows per file. Validates input data and returns all errors with field paths and plain-language fixes. (2) action=generate: Requires authenticated account with active payment for the claim (covers one GSTIN, From/To period, and both Statement 3 and Annexure B files). Returns the generated Statement 3 JSON file. Input format: Amounts as strings or numbers; dates as DD-MM-YYYY; periods as MMYYYY. Accepts JSON files from official offline utility unchanged. Constraints: 8 MB maximum file size, 10,000 rows maximum. HTTP 402 response indicates claim payment required; payment is completed on the website.
data.reasoning: Summary is clear and actionable. Description is comprehensive but could be better structured for AI agent parsing. Reorganized to clearly separate the two action modes, their requirements, and outputs. Added explicit mention of return values and error handling to improve AI interpretability.
